build_moses_tokenizer: build a MosesTokenizer with MosesTokenizerConfig to tokenize text for a given source language
encode_text_with_moses: encode a string into tokenized form using the MosesTokenizer encode method with dash split and escape options
decode_text_with_moses: decode a space-separated tokenized string back to natural text using the MosesTokenizer decode method
configure_moses_tokenizer: configure a MosesTokenizerConfig dataclass with source_lang, target_lang, moses_no_dash_splits, and moses_no_escape fields
review_moses_tokenizer_class: review the MosesTokenizer class and its encode and decode methods for sacremoses-based tokenization
